prompt:
Add a footer to the Connect design-system showcase page

First real end-to-end run for the Development agent — keep it deliberately small.

Add a footer to apps/connect/index.html: a single caption-styled line identifying the page as the focx design-system showcase, separated from the content above by a hairline top rule.

Scope is exactly that one footer. Do not restyle, reorganize, or 'improve' anything else on the page.

Everything it needs already exists in the published design system — the UI/Caption type style, border-subtle, the hairline border width, and existing spacing. Resolve every value to a published token; no raw hex, pixel, or font values. If you believe a genuine design-system gap exists, halt and report it rather than inventing a value.

Follow your charter exactly, including the Codex handoff for the actual code and a fresh independent QA pass before you close this out.
